items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Gene and I worked together in Santa Monica during the summer... So I called Gene Wright... we opened in the Sands.

ctx.x: So I don't know we had a few years of this and then I -- that dissolved, after we were in New York awhile. I went home, Oh, jeeze, I've been working hard, I'll take a little time and I did. And then I met Gene Wright, (unintelligible a guitar player) Bill Dillard, and somebody called me about going to Australia, so -- first thing I know it was suggested that the -- we get Helen, it was great, so we got Helen Humes, and a trio, we went to Australia for about three months.
Oh, I didn't realize that it was just a trio. I thought it was a six or seven piece or something.
